name: muqsit
description: Muqsit Health System — patient management & prescription system (client + server + admin monorepo)

scripts.dev:api: node init && npm --prefix server run start:dev
scripts.dev:web: node init && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.dev:admin: node init && npm --prefix admin run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix admin install
